title: MOLECULAR BIOLOGY
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the universal energy currency of living organisms."
ATP is regarded as the universal energy currency of living organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method for detecting and analysing sequences of homologous DNA."
Nucleic acid hybridisation is a method for detecting and analysing sequences of homologous DNA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the instructions for making specific proteins."
The Central Dogma Genes are the instructions for making specific proteins.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to drive endergonic reactions in cells."
The energy is used to drive endergonic reactions in cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compound consisting of 2 subunits - a pentose sugar and a nitrogen base."
A nucleoside is a compound consisting of 2 subunits - a pentose sugar and a nitrogen base.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a metabolic pathway that releases energy by breaking down complex molecules into simpler compounds."
Catabolism (catabolic pathway) is a metabolic pathway that releases energy by breaking down complex molecules into simpler compounds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of which DNA copies itself for each descendant cell or virus, passing on the information needed for protein synthesis."
Replication is the process of which DNA copies itself for each descendant cell or virus, passing on the information needed for protein synthesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of creating an equivalent RNA copy of a sequence of DNA."
Transcription is a process of creating an equivalent RNA copy of a sequence of DNA.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with understanding the mechanisms responsible for the transmission and expression of the genetic information that ultimately governs cell structure and function."
Molecular biology is concerned with understanding the mechanisms responsible for the transmission and expression of the genetic information that ultimately governs cell structure and function.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the instructions for making specific proteins."
Genes are the instructions for making specific proteins.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the essential unit for cellular division and must be replicated, divided and passed successfully to their daughter cells so as to ensure the genetic diversity and survival of their progeny."

Chromosomes are the essential unit for cellular division and must be replicated, divided and passed successfully to their daughter cells so as to ensure the genetic diversity and survival of their progeny.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a series of chemical reactions occurring within a cell."
Metabolic pathways are a series of chemical reactions occurring within a cell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the production of the proteins needed by the cell or virus for its activities and development."
Protein synthesis is the production of the proteins needed by the cell or virus for its activities and development.
fib: ______ is the set of rules by which information encoded in genetic material (DNA or mRNA sequences) is translated into proteins (amino acids) by living cells.
genetic code
The Nature of the Genetic Code The genetic code is the set of rules by which information encoded in genetic material (DNA or mRNA sequences) is translated into proteins (amino acids) by living cells.
______ is used by all known life - eukaryotes, prokaryotes and viruses - to generate the macromolecular machinery for life.
process
The process is used by all known life - eukaryotes, prokaryotes and viruses - to generate the macromolecular machinery for life.
______ is a strand of RNA that is complementary to the DNA sequence for a gene and carries the genetic blueprint copied from the sequence of bases in a cell's DNA.
Messenger - RNA
Messenger - RNA is a strand of RNA that is complementary to the DNA sequence for a gene and carries the genetic blueprint copied from the sequence of bases in a cell's DNA.
______ is the messenger - RNA (mRNA).
largest type of RNA
The largest type of RNA is the messenger - RNA (mRNA).
______ are the most abundant type of RNA and they coordinate the sequential coupling of tRNA molecules to the series of mRNA codons.
Transfer - RNA
Transfer - RNA are the most abundant type of RNA and they coordinate the sequential coupling of tRNA molecules to the series of mRNA codons.
______ refers to sequencing methods for determining the order of the nucleotides bases - adenine, guanine, cytosine and thymine - in a molecule of DNA.
DNA sequencing
DNA sequencing refers to sequencing methods for determining the order of the nucleotides bases - adenine, guanine, cytosine and thymine - in a molecule of DNA.
______ is a metabolic pathway that involves the synthesis or assembling of organic molecules and new protoplasm.
Anabolism (anabolic pathway)
Anabolism
Anabolism (anabolic pathway) is a metabolic pathway that involves the synthesis or assembling of organic molecules and new protoplasm.
______ is the most fundamental level at which genotype gives rise to the phenotype.
Gene expression
Gene expression is the most fundamental level at which genotype gives rise to the phenotype.
______ is called transfer - RNA (tRNA) which carries amino acids to the ribosomes for incorporation into a protein.
smallest type of RNA
The smallest type of RNA is called transfer - RNA (tRNA) which carries amino acids to the ribosomes for incorporation into a protein.
______ is one of the principal tools of molecular biology.
Gel electrophoresis
Gel Electrophoresis Gel electrophoresis is one of the principal tools of molecular biology.
______ is a polymer made up of repeating units of mononucleotides carrying the genetic material of all cellular organisms and most viruses.
DNA
The DNA is a polymer made up of repeating units of mononucleotides carrying the genetic material of all cellular organisms and most viruses.
______ are the deoxyribonucleic acids (DNA) and ribonucleic acids (RNA).
Two classes of nucleic acids
Two classes of nucleic acids are the deoxyribonucleic acids (DNA) and ribonucleic acids (RNA).
______ are used for making linkage maps.
Genetic markers
Genetic markers are used for making linkage maps.
According to the course material, how many types of nucleic acids - DNA (Dexyribonucleic acid) and RNA (Ribonucl are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of nucleic acids - DNA (Dexyribonucleic acid) and RNA (Ribonucleic acid); both are chemical relatives that are universally present in all living cells and they form the chemical basis of life.
